data.description: In Dungeon Defenders 2, the characters you play as are called heroes. Most heroes have 4 Abilities and 4 Defenses. The Gunwitch and Barbarian have 8 abilities and no defenses.

data.description: In Dungeon Defenders 2, the characters you play as are called heroes. Most heroes have 4 Abilities and 4 Defenses. The Gunwitch, Barbarian, and Frostweaver have 8 abilities and no defenses. The Mystic and Dryad have 3 abilities and 5 defenses

data.title: Data Table/Hero (Stats) - Dungeon Defenders II Wiki
data.description: If there's only one value, it means that the value doesn't change via character levels. The first value is the minimal value (at level 1) The second value is the maximal value (at level 50) This chart shows only level stat increase, bonuses from equipment and Ascencion aren't added. To get the increase per level simply subtract the 1st value from the 2nd value and divide it by 49.
